    max_length = 0
    tokens = []

            current_token = ""

            inside_parentheses = False

            current_token += ch
        elif ch == '_' and not inside_parentheses:
            if len(current_token) > max_length:
                max_length = len(current_token)
            current_token = ""
        elif ch == '_' and inside_parentheses:
            if len(current_token) > 0:
                tokens.append(current_token)
                current_token = ""

    if len(current_token) > max_length:
        max_length = len(current_token)

    print(f"{max_length} {len(tokens)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
